pages.title: Drum for the joy of it
text: The Songkeeper Drum is a rhythm game on **46 songs**: the Gate Rites and the Drum Circle, the music of every March land, the themes of its guardians, the **Ninjacat Skies** guardians and the **Chocobos Reborn** races. Every song plays whole, and every note is charted from a real beat in the recording.
Pick a song and a difficulty (**Easy**, **Normal**, **Hard** or **Expert**; Easy uses three drums), then strike **A**, **S**, **D** and **F** (or the arrow keys) as each drum head reaches the line.

pages.title: Playing
text: A hit is **Perfect**, **Great** or **Good** by how close it lands. A streak builds your multiplier: **x2** at 10 in a row, **x3** at 20, **x4** at 30. A miss breaks the streak and the song dips.
Glowing notes are a **Spirit Surge** phrase. Clear a whole phrase to charge the Surge meter; once it is half full, press **Space** to double every point while it lasts.
Watch the **Resonance** meter. Misses drain it, hits fill it; if it empties the song breaks and no score is kept. Easy never breaks.
If the notes and the music drift apart on your machine, set the **audio offset** in the song list. **Speed** changes how fast notes travel, and **hit sounds** add a tap on every hit.

pages.title: Scores and duels
text: The drum keeps your **best score and stars** for every song at every difficulty, and a board of the **five best** on the server. A full combo gets gold stars.

Set **two Songkeeper Drums side by side** and they become a duelling pair. From one drum, challenge the player standing at the other: you both play the same song at once, each watching the other's score in a tug-of-war bar, and the higher score wins. Your duel record shows at the top of the song list.
